## How it was tested

- [ ] `npm test` passes
- [ ] Added or updated a test for the change
- [ ] (if you run a live copy) Tried it on yourself with `TEST_ONLY_FOR`

## Checklist

- [ ] No real names, roll numbers, emails or institute sheet / Drive ids anywhere
- [ ] Batch-specific values live in `config.gs`, with a plain-English comment
- [ ] `BUILD_ID_` bumped; `RESYNC_VERSION` / `CODE_VERSION` bumped if needed
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` updated
- [ ] Credits and disclaimer kept
